newsitem.title: FINLAND: TT TIETO REPEATS POSITIVE 1997 OUTLOOK.
newsitem.headline: TT TIETO REPEATS POSITIVE 1997 OUTLOOK.

text.p: Finnish data systems and services group TT Tieto Oy on Thursday repeated that it saw conditions for a continued positive performance this year.

"The current strong demand for information technology services is expected to continue, underpinned by lively economic growth, a surge in electronic trading, preparation for European Monetary Union and the changes required for the year 2000," Tieto said in a statement with its January-June results.
"The outlook is bright and the conditions exist for continued positive performance," it said.
Tieto said it expected growth in consolidated net sales in the second half of the year to correspond with its 15 percent long-term growth target.
"The impact of acquisitions in 1996 will level off and organic growth based on strong demand will accelerate slightly, compared to the beginning of the year," it said.
Excluding the impact of acquisitions in 1996 and early this year, group net sales rose 11 percent in January-June, it said.
"Information technology services continued to be in strong demand," Tieto said.
The group's first-half pre-tax profit rose 44 percent to 123 million markka. The median of analysts' forecasts in a Reuters poll was 116 million markka in a 109-133 million range.
